items.title: Yum! Brands (YUM) Faces Franchise Fallout After 84 Store Operator Files Chapter 11
items.summary: Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) franchisee Tasty Chick'n LLC filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy, affecting 84 KFC and Taco Bell outlets. The filing cites declining sales and rising costs at the franchised restaurants as key pressures on the business. Yum! Brands has moved to terminate its franchise agreements with Tasty Chick'n LLC as part of the restructuring process. The Tasty Chick'n LLC Chapter 11 bankruptcy and related Yum! Brands franchise terminations are only one factor investors should weigh...
